$comment: A record, not a control file. Nothing in @piotr-miller/ai-toolkit reads this file; it exists so a human, or an agent onboarding into this repository, can see which package, tools and exact version own the authoring skills here, without a private dependency and without tracked installation state. The CLI's own state lives in .ai-toolkit/manifest.json, which is gitignored. Since 1.8.0 this repository takes every channel (setup), as lumina-clean-ai does: managed skills, the recovery channel and Millrune. The recovery channel and Millrune are course-licensed, so they are installed locally only and never tracked - .gitignore covers every path setup writes - see README.md, Repository tooling.
auth: user-level npm credential, read:packages - see the package's docs/bootstrap-auth.md
